long_biography.plain_text:
MÄHREN began with a single Berlin apartment that Jakob Mähren bought, renovated and sold after earning his starting capital through day trading. He formed the business in 2002 and moved from individual flats into multifamily houses in districts then overlooked by larger investors.

The group developed an integrated model covering acquisitions, investment management, asset management and marketing. Mähren sold an early portfolio before the financial crisis, reinvested after prices fell and expanded beyond Berlin. The business concentrates on residential and mixed-use properties, with Berlin and the Rhine-Ruhr metropolitan area as its central German markets.
